Sandbox_LugliEL_GlowStickHours_tooltip: How many in-game hours a cracked glow stick stays lit. It cannot be put out early, so this is the whole of the decision to crack one.
Sandbox_LugliEL_ChemLightHours_tooltip: How many in-game hours a cracked chem light stays lit. It cannot be put out early, so this is the whole of the decision to crack one.
Sandbox_LugliEL_RoadFlareHours_tooltip: How many in-game hours a cracked road flare stays lit. It cannot be put out early, so this is the whole of the decision to crack one.
Sandbox_LugliEL_GlowStickRadius_tooltip: How far a burning glow stick throws light. The value is used as written: this mod places its own lights, so the engine's 20-tile clamp does not apply.
Sandbox_LugliEL_ChemLightRadius_tooltip: How far a burning chem light throws light. The value is used as written: this mod places its own lights, so the engine's 20-tile clamp does not apply.
Sandbox_LugliEL_RoadFlareRadius_tooltip: How far a burning road flare throws light. The value is used as written: this mod places its own lights, so the engine's 20-tile clamp does not apply.
Sandbox_LugliEL_LightIntensity_tooltip: How bright a burning item's light is, in your hand and on the ground alike. They are the same light: this mod switches off the engine's warm carry torch so that a green stick reads green whether you are holding it or standing next to it.
Sandbox_LugliEL_LightSaturation_tooltip: How much of its own colour a burning item casts on the world. A real light is never one pure wavelength, and lighting a room with the raw colour of a red chem light drowns it in red. Lower values mix toward white, so it still reads red without everything it touches turning red. 1 is the item's pure colour.
Sandbox_LugliEL_LightFlicker_tooltip: A burning road flare pulses its light instead of glowing steadily. Turn it off for a small performance saving.
Sandbox_LugliEL_LightIncidence_tooltip: Real light is never perfectly steady: a stick shifts as it is carried and a flare's flame breathes. This adds a small, slow variation to every burning light. Deliberately subtle -- anything stronger reads as a fault rather than as life.
Sandbox_LugliEL_ThrowRangeMult_tooltip: Scales how far a lit stick can be thrown. Each family has its own base range, so this moves all of them together rather than flattening them to one number.
Sandbox_LugliEL_CrackNoise_tooltip: How far away zombies hear you crack a stick or strike a flare. Quieter than a wristwatch alarm, which the engine puts at 7. Zero is silent.
Sandbox_LugliEL_ThrowNoise_tooltip: How far away zombies hear a thrown item hit the ground. The engine's own thrown objects emit 600, a ringing house alarm, which is why this mod places its own items and makes exactly the noise you ask for. Zero is silent.
Sandbox_LugliEL_FlareNoise_tooltip: How far away zombies are drawn to a burning road flare, REPEATED every second for its whole burn. Between an alarm clock and a running generator. A continuous sound at this radius is a much stronger draw than a single shot at the same number, so it does not need to be near the guns to matter. Zero makes flares silent.
Sandbox_LugliEL_FlareGunNoise_tooltip: How far away zombies hear the flare gun fire, once, when you pull the trigger. About a snub revolver, which is the quietest real firearm the engine ships. It is a cartridge discharge, so it is the loudest single noise in this mod.
Sandbox_LugliEL_AerialNoise: Noise: flare burning in the sky (tiles)
Sandbox_LugliEL_AerialNoise_tooltip: How far away zombies are drawn to a fired flare while it burns overhead, REPEATED for its whole life. Louder than a handheld flare because being found is the entire point of firing one.
Sandbox_LugliEL_AerialShotRange_tooltip: How far from you a fired flare comes down. The aim is clamped to this, so a shot at the horizon lands here instead. Longer shots fly for longer and arc higher.
Sandbox_LugliEL_AerialSeconds_tooltip: How long a fired flare stays burning in the sky, in IN-GAME seconds, so it scales with your day length exactly as the burn times above do.
Sandbox_LugliEL_AerialLightRadius_toolti: How far a fired flare lights the ground beneath it. One light, and the value is used as written.
Sandbox_LugliEL_AerialRange_tooltip: How far the sky itself lights up when a cartridge is fired. This is the coloured glow over the landscape, not the light on the ground, and it is deliberately far larger.
Sandbox_LugliEL_FlareWash_tooltip: A burning flare washes the sky with colour, the way the engine's own signal flares do. Turn it off to keep every flare a purely local light.
Sandbox_LugliEL_FlareFire_tooltip: Draws an actual flame on a burning road flare: a white-hot core, a bloom around it, and tongues of fire thrown out of the burning end, wherever that end happens to be pointing. A ground item is rendered once into a texture and then blitted, so nothing inside the mesh can move however it is shaded. Glow sticks and chem lights never get one: they are a cold reaction with no flame at all.
Sandbox_LugliEL_CarriedFlareSound_toolti: A burning road flare keeps making noise when it is in your bag rather than in your hand, quietly. Turn it off if a flare you are carrying somewhere is more distracting than atmospheric.
Sandbox_LugliEL_MapMarker_tooltip: A burning flare puts a blinking marker on your world map.
Sandbox_LugliEL_MapRangeCircle: Map: show range as a circle
Sandbox_LugliEL_MapRangeCircle_tooltip: Draws that marker at the flare's true coverage radius rather than as a small dot. Off by default, because at a long range the circle covers most of the visible map.
Sandbox_LugliEL_LootMultiplier_tooltip: Scales how often these items appear in containers. Zero removes them from loot entirely, leaving them craftable or admin-spawned only.
Sandbox_LugliEL_SweepRadius_tooltip: How far around you the mod re-checks burning items it has already found: burning out, swapping to a spent one, refreshing colour. It no longer decides what gets LIT -- items are found as their chunk loads, across the whole streamed world and on every floor -- so this only needs to cover what you can see. Lower costs less.
Sandbox_LugliEL_SweepSeconds_tooltip: How often that scan runs, in real seconds: this is a frame-time setting, not a world duration, so it does not follow your day length. Raise it to get frame time back.
Sandbox_LugliEL_DebugLog: Debug: write diagnostics to the console
Sandbox_LugliEL_DebugLog_tooltip: Logs what the mod is doing to the console and the debug log: every throw's aim, landing and error, the pose an item came to rest in, each flare gun shot's apex and wind lean, and every ceiling strike. Off by default because a mod that writes three lines every time you throw something buries everything else in the log. Faults are always reported whatever this is set to.
Sandbox_LugliEL_DebugRanges: Debug: draw ranges in the world
Sandbox_LugliEL_DebugRanges_tooltip: Draws every radius this mod uses as a labelled ring on the ground: the noise a burning flare makes, how far its light reaches, how far you can fire the gun, and what a fired flare covers. A number of tiles is hard to picture and a circle around your feet is not, so this is the honest way to decide whether the noise settings above are sensible.
